fg.$description: Medium-emphasis ink for the disclosure summary and its steps.

bg.$description: Fill behind the disclosure summary and its steps.

bg-image.$description: Optional image painted over the disclosure fill.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete filter behind the disclosure. None keeps the backdrop clear.

border.$description: Ink of the decorative rule at the inline start of the steps.

summary-gap.$description: Space between the summary text and glyphs and between separate step blocks.

body-gap.$description: Block spacing between the summary and the step content.

body-indent.$description: Inline spacing between the rule and the content.

list-indent.$description: Inline space for markers on a slotted list.

shimmer-fg.$description: Readable highlight at the midpoint of the thinking shimmer.

shimmer-easing.$description: Easing into and out of the thinking highlight.
